rationale: The anonymous proposition reconstructs the main mathematical backbone of Example 2.7.8 and its immediate psi-gauge context: sub-Gaussian variables are sub-exponential, squaring exchanges psi-two and psi-one gauges, exponential laws have the displayed mean and variance scales, and Poisson laws have finite psi-one gauge. Nevertheless, source-to-translation implication fails for the definite arbitrary-measure generalization, while translation-to-source implication remains unclear because the canonical gamma-measure presentation is not explicitly connected to the source's nonnegative tail characterization in the allowed evidence. The translation also fixes C=2, includes zero-rate Poisson, omits the unresolved N(mu,sigma) illustration, and collapses the variance-versus-standard-deviation prose distinction. These issues require adjudication, so the result is undetermined and not accepted.
